extracted.intended_audience: organizations seeking grants from Carnegie Corporation of New York; current grantees
extracted.subtask_description: High-level guidance on Carnegie Corporation's grantmaking approach and instructions for prospective applicants and current grantees, emphasizing proactive selection, collaborative planning, and measurable impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proactive grantmaking / program officer identification
rubrics_metrics.description: Carnegie Corporation of New York is a proactive grantmaker. Program staff identify organizations to implement projects that are designed to help the foundation attain its various programmatic goals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nearly all of the organizations we fund are identified and contacted by Corporation program officers. This implies that funding is primarily by invitation/selection rather than open unsolicited applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preference for innovative projects
rubrics_metrics.description: Our aim is to invest in innovative projects that can have measurable impact and can create meaningful, transformative change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects should demonstrate innovation, measurable impact, and the potential for meaningful, transformative change; these are core priorities in selection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collaborative, intensive planning before award
rubrics_metrics.description: Intensive and collaborative planning between the Corporation and the institutions it has identified generally precedes the awarding of grants and is an integral step in our grantmaking.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Successful proposals/awards involve close planning with Corporation program staff; applicants should expect substantive pre-award collaboration rather than one-way application review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understand program-specific goals, strategies, and limitations
rubrics_metrics.description: Please read the information on our website about the Corporation’s grantmaking programs, goals and strategies, and any limitations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prospective applicants should consult program pages to confirm alignment with program goals and any restrictions before seeking funding or contacting program staff.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the grants database to review past awards
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are seeking information about past grants awarded by Carnegie Corporation, please visit our grants database.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewing past grants can help applicants understand the types of organizations and projects the Corporation funds and inform whether a proposed project is likely to align.

rubrics_metrics.name: Current grantee reporting, modification, and communications procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are a current grantee seeking information about reporting on a grant, modifying a grant, and communications regarding a grant, please visit our grantees section.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Existing grantees should follow the Corporation's specified processes (via the grantees section) for reporting requirements, amendment requests, and communications; procedural compliance is expected.
